title: Clinical Evaluation of the FilmArray® Global Fever (GF) Panel
brief_summary: This study will evaluate the clinical sensitivity and specificity of the FilmArray Global Fever (GF) Panel.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Whole blood in EDTA (prospectively collected via informed consent)
* Subject has a recorded or self-reported fever within the past two days.
* Subject has not participated in the study within the last 30 days.
study_population: Subjects with fever will be prospectively enrolled, and whole blood will be collected.
